modality.INPUT: DNA sequence (reference genome) + ATAC accessibility signal (bigWig), per gene
modality.OUTPUT: single scalar = predicted expression of that gene
modality.note: There is NO expression encoder. scRNA cannot be an input; it is only the OUTPUT/readout.

granularity: per-GENE forward pass over all peaks within +/-300 kb of the gene TSS (<=150 peaks; padded to 150)

per_peak_input.dna_line: exactly 1029 bp (A/C/G/T), centered on the peak summit
per_peak_input.atac_line: exactly 1029 whitespace-separated floats = bigWig signal at the SAME 1029 genomic positions as the DNA
per_peak_input.file_layout: 3 lines per peak (ID, DNA, ATAC); n peaks -> 3n lines; peaks ordered along genome

tokenization.dna: overlapping 6-mers via tokenizer(seq,6) -> 1029-6+1 = 1024 tokens -> mapped by kmer_dict (4100 vocab: [PAD]=0,[CLS]=1,[SEP]=2,[MASK]=3, then 4096 6-mers) -> reshaped 8x128
tokenization.atac: pre_pro(sig,6): 6-bp moving-average -> 1024 values -> discretized into 36 bins (0->1, ... , >=200->36) -> reshaped 8x128
tokenization.note: 1024 = 8 sub-blocks x 128; Encoder-1 runs per sub-block, Encoder-2 over the 8 blocks + attention-pool -> 1 vector/peak, Encoder-3 over <=150 peaks, FF head -> scalar.

sidecar_params_per_gene.tss_loc: integer index (0-based) of the peak closest to the gene TSS within the ordered peak list
sidecar_params_per_gene.direction: '+' or '-' gene strand; sets the TSS-distance (pos3) embedding direction

perturbation_recipe.edit_target: ATAC signal vector ONLY (DNA sequence and peak set are IDENTICAL between Ref and perturbed files)
perturbation_recipe.KO: set the target peak's 1029 ATAC values to 0 (validated example: enhancer chrX_48761672_48762478, org max 651.9 -> ko 0.0; exactly 1 peak differs between shipped info_ko_org.txt and info_ko_ko.txt)
perturbation_recipe.KI_OSKM: per paper p.9: 'inducing the highest ATAC peak flanking the 300,000-bp of the TSS of targeted gene to the loci with OSKM motifs' => at peaks bearing OCT4/SOX2/KLF4/MYC motifs, raise the ATAC signal to the window's highest-peak profile (mimicking OSKM binding+opening those loci)
perturbation_recipe.readout_for_fate: run Ref and perturbed inputs for the full readout gene panel -> two predicted-expression vectors; cell-state proximity = cosine similarity of predicted expression to the TARGET state's profile (paper Fig 4B/4C; somatic->iPSC example: cos sim to hESC rose ~0.23 -> ~0.75 after OSKM-KI)
